label.purpose: Table headers, status pills and compact metadata.

shadows.name: overlay-only
shadows.purpose: Snackbar and the detail-page bookmark actions popup only (the only legal overlay shadow value).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global reduced-motion override for transitions and animations.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Wrap toolbars and stack selected task, history, settings and Pixiv browser controls.

density.name: control-density
density.purpose: Material Web outlined text fields and selects unified via size-token overrides only (main.css control-density layer: top/bottom space 8px, input text 14px, line height 24px); buttons keep Material defaults; component appearance untouched.

components.name: Novel Translation
components.description: A wrapping surface toolbar above the existing reader pager: outlined Translate/Retranslate, Original/Translation/Bilingual native text toggle buttons with aria-pressed (Bilingual initially), secondary-container/on-secondary-container selection and control radius. Translation follows each source paragraph/chapter in primary, paper mode mixes primary 20% with ink 80% for contrast across themes, same reader type/line height, lang=zh-CN, plain text; images remain single. Missing translations explicitly indicated, no source fallback in translation-only. 12px muted live stage status, readable error role and retry, old translations retained. Existing 4/8/16px spacing, divider, Material hover/focus/disabled, no new motion. Settings group: straight Material API URL, password Key with saved-state-only placeholder/blank-preserve/clear-on-save, model ID and five-line JSON with inline validation; disclose Chinese target, two requests and page/metadata/600-character adjacent context. Existing Save/Cancel and dirty checks.

components.name: In-app Update
components.description: Native m3-dialog; width min(480px, 90vw), max-height 88vh. One dialog switches confirmation, download, opening, error, cancelled and platform installation guide. Material Web progress and buttons; wrapping filenames/paths and stats, tabular numerals, progress/bytes/speed text. Escape cancels download and waits during opening; pending cancel disabled. Retry/release recovery, directory/path fallback, no automatic quit or claim of installed success. Existing tokens and reduced-motion rules.

components.name: Author Follow
components.description: Author profile actions: 40px Material filled Follow / outlined Following button beside external-link control, 8px gap, wrapping on narrow windows. Public follow; clicking Following unfollows with action tooltip/aria-label and aria-pressed. Only confirmed success updates state and Snackbar; failures preserve it. Busy disables duplicates and refresh, marks aria-busy. Missing status disables with refresh hint; own profile hides follow. Ignore old account/profile replies. Work lists remain intact.

components.name: Detail Metadata
components.description: Artwork/manga retain the information column; novels show likes, bookmarks and views in the existing 12px metadata line and the description before the body. Counts preserve zero and locale formatting. Description is inert plain text with decoded entities and preserved paragraphs/line breaks, pre-wrap and anywhere wrapping. Tag chips are native search links carrying the original word, work kind and exact-tag matching, with existing hover colors and a primary 2px focus-visible ring at 2px offset. Counts wrap, long tags wrap, empty descriptions/tags disappear; no new color, icon or motion tokens.

components.name: Return Navigation
components.description: Non-work pages share PageBackButton: a 40x40 md-icon-button with a 20px official Lucide chevron-left (stroke 2) in on-surface-variant, without permanent text or a separate row. Lists and image search place it left of the title in page-heading (center-aligned flex, --space-sm gap, min-width:0 wrapping title). Author pages place it left of the avatar/profile column with 16px top spacing to center against the 72px avatar, retaining this position in narrow windows; series pages integrate it into the series title; Tools places it beside the single Downloads heading. Artwork/novel details retain existing topbar positions. Native router history preserves the actual entry chain, including related works. Read history and execute back through the page-injected router, never a module singleton; recompute predecessor availability on full-route changes so hot updates retain the real source chain. Tooltip and aria-label say Back to previous page or Back to home without an in-app predecessor; replace returns to the owning core entry, or home from a core entry, without creating a loop, and home with no history hides the button. Loading, empty and error states retain it; skeleton aria-hidden never covers the button. Existing Material hover, focus and keyboard behavior; no new tokens or motion.

components.name: Filled Button
components.description: Material Web primary action such as start, save, resume or confirm.

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Material Web secondary action such as browse, sync or batch delete.

components.name: Form Controls
components.description: Material Web controls for source IDs, settings and selection, unified to 40px height and 14px input text by control-density size tokens (main.css); appearance untouched. Settings fields sit in a grouped dialog (left rail switches section, see Settings Dialog): General (startup page / output dir / formats / language), Appearance (theme / palette), Images & Content (Image quality: list-grid / detail / fullscreen thumbnail tiers, defaults medium / medium / large; Content: the R-18 toggle, default true), Advanced (SauceNAO API key / max wait) and Maintenance (clear logs / clear login rows) — Startup uses the same md-outlined-select density with Discover (default, recommended home) / Following / My library / Downloads; its hint says changes take effect next time the app opens. Save and Cancel follow the whole-form semantics; same form/fieldset structure at 40px density with no new tokens.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Four core entries: Discover / Following / Library / Downloads. Existing 256px sidebar collapses to 72px, uses 48px capsule items, account footer and primary-container selection. Detail pages inherit the actual origin group; direct detail links default to Discover. Downloads shows active task count. Secondary content navigation preserves existing browse routes. List views own their navigation below the back/title/action row, with native route-link pills and aria-current, 16px between groups and 24px before filters/content; Discover channel links have a subtle separator. Landing sections use their core name as the heading, specific channels retain their titles. Following filters sit side by side and wrap. Download parent owns the single heading/New download row, content-width tabs beneath; task category and management controls form separate wrapping groups. No extra section navigation in detail pages.

components.name: Account Menu
components.description: Light popover anchored above the sidebar avatar chip: width 264px, surface-container background, 12px radius, the established soft shadow 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%), no dark scrim (a transparent layer only catches click-outside, Escape closes too); holds the account list (current one checked, click to switch), add-account, a divider, the Settings entry (icon + label + trailing caret) and logout (danger label, disabled when logged out). 40px menu rows with 8% primary hover; 0.15s ease pop from the bottom-left origin (reduced-motion covered globally); sits below the snackbar z-order.

components.name: Settings Dialog
components.description: Modal native dialog opened by the account menu's Settings entry (the menu closes first, one overlay at a time): width min(840px, 94vw) and a fixed height min(680px, 88vh) (no min-/max-height, so the dialog does not jump when switching groups; a group taller than that scrolls inside the right column while the header and the footer save bar stay put), surface-container background with the shared 28px radius and scrim. Three rows: a header (title + close button); a 176px | 1fr grid (rows minmax(0, 1fr), without which the columns overflow-y does not engage) whose left rail lists the groups in components/settings/sections.ts order (General / Appearance / Images & Content / Advanced / Maintenance, labels from settings.groups.*) reusing the app sidebar nav recipe (primary-container selected, 8% primary hover, focus-visible 2px primary ring) at dialog density (40px rows, 20px pill, full-bleed width) divided from the right column by an outline-35% vertical divider, each column scrolling on its own; and a persistent footer bar (divider + right-aligned Cancel / Save) that never scrolls with the form, Save writing all settings in one pass (no per-group save). Escape, backdrop click or the header close button run a dirty check first: with unsaved changes a second 360px confirmation dialog opens (heading plus Keep editing / Discard changes, the shared confirm recipe), and discarding rolls back to the saved values (theme preview included) with a snackbar; with no changes it closes directly. Below 640px the rail becomes a horizontally scrollable pill row and the form moves to the next row. Sits below the snackbar z-order.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Native dialog recipe kept in one place (main.css dialog layer): surface-container, 28px radius, 24px padding, 35% scrim, 18px/700 headline; supporting text right after the headline uses on-surface-variant, and .dialog-actions right-aligns the button row with a 24px top gap. Material Web's dialog component is not used.

components.name: Task Progress
components.description: Material Web linear progress paired with text-first status and metadata.

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: Global top-right notification that disappears after 3.2 seconds.

components.name: App Pagination
components.description: Cross-domain pager in components/common covering total echo, page-size select, prev/next, a page window with ellipsis, a quick-jump input group (aligned with antd showQuickJumper) and compact responsive collapse; a controlled stateless component emitting update:currentPage / update:pageSize / change (v-model friendly; resetting to page 1 after a size switch stays with the parent). Pass total or totalPages (one of the two; totalPages wins) for a known pageCount, or neither for the unknown-total simple mode: no page window, a constant 'Page N' label and next gated by hasNext (default true). Default look is a four-segment row: the '{count} items' total line on the left (14px/500 on-surface-variant, overridable by the #start slot for ranking rank ranges), prev/next plus the page window in the middle, the quick-jump input group at the row end (margin-left auto), and the size select rightmost (hugging the jump group's right; the two form the row-end pair). All row controls share a uniform 32px control height (expressed as --space-lg * 2, vertically centered by the row's flex layout; the sub-640px compact state follows the same rule). The size dropdown renders only when pageSizeOptions is given, as a small native select ({n} / page options, 32px tall, 13px text, surface-container background, 45% outline border, radius-control corner, same recipe as the reader jump select); the quick-jump input group renders only in the default variant with a known pageCount > 1 (hidden for a single page and in the unknown-total mode) as a label of three inline parts — 'Go to' + an input[type=text][inputmode=numeric] + 'Page'; the input is 48px wide (--space-xl * 2), 32px tall, 13px centered text, surface-container background, 45% outline border, radius-control corner (same recipe as the size select), with a focus-visible 2px primary ring (2px offset); on Enter or blur the input is parsed — an integer landing inside 1..pageCount navigates through the existing update:currentPage + change chain and clears the field, out-of-range or non-numeric input only clears the field without navigating; when the whole component is disabled the input is disabled too and the group's labels fall back to the outline role; prev/next are self-drawn 32px pill icon buttons with 20px official Lucide chevrons (stroke 2, 8% primary hover state layer, never text glyphs); page numbers are 32px self-drawn pill buttons (999px radius, 14px/500) with the current one in secondary-container / on-secondary-container marked aria-current=page, unselected hover as an 8% primary state layer and disabled text falling back to the outline role; the window shows every page at pageCount <= 7, otherwise first/last plus a current±2 window and a plain-text ellipsis (the ellipsis itself is not clickable). Under 640px (compact) the window collapses to '{current} / {total}' (unknown mode keeps 'Page N') while prev/next, the quick-jump group and the size select remain (wrapping naturally via flex-wrap). variant=reader reuses the novel-reader sticky recipe (surface background, top divider, prev/next icon buttons + 'Page X / Y' jump select) without the window or total area; it lays out as a three-column grid (1fr auto 1fr) with the paging group pinned to grid-column 2 so it stays centered, an optional #leading slot in column 1 (the novel reader hangs its font-size zoom control there) and an optional #trailing slot in column 3 (justify-self end + min-width 0; the novel reader hangs its reading-progress slider there, see Novel Reader) - with neither slot the visual matches a plain centered pager. Transitions stay at 0.15s ease, no shadow, and custom controls carry a focus-visible 2px primary ring (2px offset).

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Browse artwork card: 12px rounded cover, two-line title, pill badges for page count and R-18 (ink/surface), hover 8% primary state layer, no shadow. Small previews load first, then upgrade to the configured grid tier without blanking; failures keep the preview and try the original URL. WorkGrid prioritizes the first 12 previews with eager/high and keeps later previews lazy; upgrades use low priority. Whole card is clickable; cover-corner quick actions (see Card Quick Actions) render on browse channel cards only.

components.name: Card Quick Actions
components.description: Cover-corner quick actions on browse channel cards: 28px pill icon buttons in surface-container/ink, revealed on hover or focus-within, 8%/12% primary state layers, reduced-motion aware; buttons sit outside the role=button card and carry aria-label + title. Bookmark page cards may render the same-spec Remove-bookmark heart action (only when the item carries a bookmarkId).

components.name: Work Grid
components.description: auto-fill minmax(160px,1fr) grid with static skeleton blocks (no shimmer), empty/error/retry states and no-more footer.

components.name: Viewer Stage
components.description: Artwork view height follows the available main-pane container (100cqh minus vertical page padding), with min-height 0 so bottom panels do not hide controls. Full-page artwork viewer stage with no self background - it shares the page surface (white in the light theme, the surface role in dark); artwork is full-bleed (square page boxes; the scroll area keeps zero padding on the top/left/bottom and 6px on the right so artwork never touches the scrollbar, matching the info column recipe) with the stage's own 16px radius + overflow hidden carrying the overall rounding. Multi-page works read as a vertical scroll stage: pages stack top to bottom and load only near the viewport (static surface-container placeholder blocks reserved to the page aspect ratio, 2:3 fallback, low-res layer before the detail tier, so loading never shifts the layout); single-page works and the masked state center the artwork vertically in the stage instead of stacking. A page box is itself the fullscreen entry and is keyboard reachable (tabindex=0 + role=button, Enter / Space opens the overlay at that page, focus-visible primary 2px inset ring), while the masked state is not focusable (tabindex=-1); a bottom-right 'N / M' dark pill badge (12px/600, white on rgb(0 0 0 / 0.78)) follows scrolling; the stage is focusable and scrolls natively (focus returns to it when the overlay closes), smooth scrolling disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, and both the stage and the right info column scroll on the same 6px always-visible scrollbar with an outline-derived thumb (color-mix 40%, 60% on hover) and a transparent track. The R-18 blur(24px) mask (rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4) wash, white copy, filled confirm button) is remembered per session and only appears while the show_r18 setting is off (deep-link fallback); with show_r18 on (default) the detail page shows no confirmation overlay. While masked only the first page is loaded, blurred, and the overlay cannot be bypassed.

components.name: Novel Reader
components.description: Available main-pane height (100cqh, excluding the status bar and bottom panel) three-row flex frame: a top bar (not sticky, flush with the window top) / the single middle scroll layer (.reader-scroll: flex 1, min-height 0, overflow-y auto, 6px slim scrollbar) / the App Pagination reader-variant footer, with only the middle layer scrolling. The text column has no max width by default (fills the middle area) and caps at 1280px only above 1920x1080 (the 1921px width / 1081px height OR media query); body text is a 16px base x --novel-scale (from the novel_font_scale setting, default 1.0, range 0.75-2.0, invalid values rejected by the backend and falling back to 1.0 at load) at line-height 1.8, and chapter headings are 1.15em/700. Novel embedded images ([uploadedimage:id] resolved through the detail response's embedded_images map to a pximg URL, shown via the pixiv-img proxy) render as centred full-column blocks (max-width 100%, --radius-control, 1.5em vertical margin, loading lazy), or as inline thumbnails (max-height 1.6em, vertical-align middle, 0.25em side margins) when mixed into a paragraph; markers with no URL (unknown id, [pixivimage:illustId]) keep the dashed placeholder block (--radius-control, outline 45% dashed, --ink-muted 12px icon plus the browse.novel.imageUnsupported label) instead of dropping the image silently, with browse.novel.imageAlt as the alt text. A font-size zoom control ([−] [100%] [+] [reset], 0.1 steps, disabled at the bounds; reset returns to 100% and is disabled at 100%, aria-live percentage) hangs in the pager's leading slot (see App Pagination). The pager's trailing slot carries a reading-progress control: an md-slider (min 0 / max 100 / step 1, 200px wide, narrowing to 140px under 640px) with the percentage echoed to its RIGHT (ink-muted 13px, 44px fixed width against jitter; the span itself is aria-hidden - the value is announced through the slider's aria-label browse.novel.readProgress and valuenow). Progress means the scroll position within the current page: scrollTop / (scrollHeight - clientHeight) rounded to a percent, tracked live by a passive scroll listener and a ResizeObserver on the scroll layer plus the content column (lazy embedded images, font scaling, panel switches, window resizes; re-attached after load/page switches once the DOM settles); with no scroll headroom (short content) it reads 100%. Dragging the handle seeks immediately: the input event maps the percent to a scrollTo position and optimistically syncs the echo (progressPercent updates straight from input), with the scroll echo demoted to confirmation - it always equals the optimistic value (integer-aligned at step 1, no feedback loop), so the display never drifts even where a programmatic scrollTo dispatches no scroll event (hidden window / throttled webview rendering); returning to the page top on page switches resets it to 0. Slider visuals map to existing roles only: handle (hover/focus/pressed) and active track in primary, inactive track in color-mix(outline 30%, transparent) (same recipe as the bar's top divider and the scrollbar thumb), handle shadow color transparent - the package defaults reference surface-container-highest / shadow roles this app does not define; height is pulled down to the bar's 32px control convention via --md-slider-state-layer-size. ArrowLeft/ArrowRight while the slider is focused adjust the slider, not pages: its focus lives in the shadow input[type=range] so the window-level page-key guard resolves the real event source via composedPath()[0].closest('input, select, [role=slider]'). The top bar carries back / title / author / bookmark / comments / fill-form / open-in-browser (see Detail Topbar Actions) and the column ends in the switchable related-works / comments panel (see Detail Panel). A reading-background picker (NovelBgPicker) hangs right of the reset button in the leading slot: the trigger is an md-icon-button carrying an 18px circular swatch echoing the current paper color (follow-theme = surface fill + 1px outline border so it stays visible on the bar); clicking pops a one-row bubble centered above the button (AccountMenu popover recipe: surface-container background, radius-control corner, the established soft shadow 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%), transparent fixed backdrop for outside-click close, Esc closes with native dialogs taking precedence, focus moves into the panel (tabindex -1) and returns to the trigger on close, 0.15s ease rise with transform-origin bottom center, reduced-motion covered globally). Swatches are six 28px circles (role=radio + aria-checked) filled with the paper color itself (default = surface fill + outline border); the selected one gets a 2px primary outline at 2px offset; a click applies immediately and persists the novel_bg_color setting (semantic key, empty string = follow theme, written through settings_save). The five self-contained paper/ink pairs (bg / body ink / muted): green #c8e6ce/#1f3a2e/#52685c, kraft #e6d7b8/#433722/#75684d, warm #f3e4d0/#463526/#7c6753, mist #e1ebf2/#263844/#5c7180, blush #f5e7e5/#46302f/#7f6462. No new color tokens: the selected key adds a read-bg-* class on the .novel-view root so top bar, content and bottom bar all go paper by remapping existing roles inside that subtree (surface and --surface = bg, on-surface and --ink = ink, on-surface-variant and --ink-muted = muted, surface-container = color-mix(ink 6% into bg), outline and --ink-subtle = color-mix(ink 45% into bg)); derived surfaces, dividers and scrollbar thumbs follow automatically, and dark theme renders the same light paper on purpose (a self-contained, always-readable pair scoped to the reader page).

components.name: Series Episode Page
components.description: Series episode page at /browse/series/:kind(novel|illust)/:id (legacy /browse/series/:id functionally redirects to the novel segment; watchlist 'manga' is watchlist semantics mapped to 'illust' at entry points), shared by novel and illustration/manga series. Header: 120px square cover (12px radius; an empty illust series cover falls back to the first episode cover) + single-line ellipsis title (wraps under 640px) + author link + HTML-stripped caption + an 'N episodes - status' stat line (12px/600 on-surface-variant; the illust endpoint has no completion flag so it always reads Ongoing) + action row (novel: fill form + open on pixiv; illustration/manga: open on pixiv only). Below it a toolbar: a 'Series contents' label (12px/600 on-surface-variant) on the left and the shared ViewModeToggle component (browse/ViewModeToggle.vue) on the right - official Lucide layout-grid / list paths at stroke 2 in 30px pill buttons with 18px icons; selected = secondary-container / on-secondary-container, unselected = transparent + ink with 8% on-surface hover, aria-pressed + aria-label, focus-visible 2px primary ring; mode is remembered per session, defaulting to grid for illust and list for novel. Grid repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px,1fr)) (same as WorkGrid): illust cover cards = 1:1 cover + a top-left #N pill (999px, 12px/600, surface-container/ink, same recipe as the work-card page-count badge) + a top-right R-18 badge (ink background, surface text) + a two-line clamped title with a page-count/date subline; novel tile cards = surface-container background, a 20px/600 #N, two-line title and word-count meta, 8% primary hover. List = 48px+ rows (surface-container rounded container, hairline dividers, 8% primary hover; illust rows add a 48px thumbnail and #N, novel rows keep the zero-padded order/title/right-aligned meta; under 640px the title wraps and meta drops to its own line). Pager reuses the novel-reader recipe (sticky bottom, prev/next + page select, disabled at bounds): novel 30 per page (last_order=(page-1)*30), illust 12 per page (native page-based endpoint); page switches keep old content with a local opacity transition (no flicker) and first paint uses static skeleton blocks. The global R-18 filter applies to episode entries only (same in grid and list), never to the header. Entry points: watchlist cards, work/novel detail series navigation and search ID direct-jump (novel/series/{id} → novel segment, user/{uid}/series/{sid} → illust segment) all land here.

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: Channel section headings are 16px/600 on-surface-variant; tag-recommendation blocks (illustration channel only, placed between Daily Ranking and Latest Posts) emphasize the #TagName in on-surface with a muted 'recommended illustrations' suffix, show up to 12 cards each, and join the shared R-18 render-time filter (a fully filtered-out block disappears as a whole and feeds the hidden count). Kind/period switches use secondary md-tabs; the Downloads page reuses the same secondary tabs (SectionTabs wrapper) as its sub-route navigator; top-three ranking badges use primary-container.

components.name: Login Guard
components.description: Browse commands on a logged-out session return a fixed message and open the existing login dialog; browse views never re-implement login UI.

components.name: Browse List Header
components.description: Home, illustration/manga/novel channels, discover, feed, watchlist, search, ranking, bookmarks, browsing history, author works and series contents provide Refresh. Title left, actions right, wrapping at narrow widths; author/series refresh-only rows align right. Shared md-text-button with an 18px stroke icon and existing spacing; busy text, disabled and aria-busy during requests, shortcut tooltip plus aria-keyshortcuts for Control+R / Meta+R. Only the active list responds, and open modal dialogs and focus in the download form suppress background shortcut refresh; manual buttons stay available. Refresh retains filters and scrolls content to top; infinite lists restart at the first batch, numbered lists retain the current page. Home Shuffle stays as a separate append action.

components.name: Browse Search
components.description: Search page filter row: type md-tabs plus three md-outlined-selects (order / mode / match-mode) and a trailing 'Sort this page' group, each select carrying a 12px/600 --ink-muted external label; selects size to the selected option text and never shrink (flex: none - Material's inner label wraps under narrow widths and inflates the select to 64px), so the row stays single-line in normal windows, moves the sort group to a second line below 1040px and stacks below 640px. The result bar keeps only the 'About N results' total plus the count-fetch progress (the local sort no longer occupies its own row). The sort group is a dimension md-outlined-select (default / likes / bookmarks / views, default 'default' - the value must be non-empty, an empty-string option is not recognised by Material and renders as a blank select) plus a reusable SortDirectionToggle (components/common) - two 30px icon toggles (inline lucide arrow-up-narrow-wide / arrow-down-wide-narrow paths, 18px, stroke 2) with a secondary-container / on-secondary-container selected state, transparent background plus --ink otherwise, an 8% on-surface hover layer, aria-pressed plus ascending/descending labels, a group-level sort-direction label, a primary 2px focus-visible ring and no transition under prefers-reduced-motion; the whole toggle is disabled until a sort dimension is chosen. Sorting applies to the current 20-item page only: the three metrics are fetched in batches through browse_work_counts (progress 'Loading counts n/m...', missing items sort last) and switching dimension or direction reuses the session count cache without refetching.

components.name: Browse Search Paged Grid
components.description: The numbered-pagination WorkGrid (search page, 20 items per page) takes its column count from the divisors of the page size - 2 / 4 / 5 / 10 - so every row is filled and the last row is never partial. The tier follows the inline size of the surrounding query container (.grid-host, container-type: inline-size) with breakpoints at 608 / 764 / 1544px (= columns x 140px minimum card width + (columns - 1) x 16px column gap); with no container ancestor it falls back to 2 columns. Pure CSS @container, no resize listeners. Column count never affects the page size or pagination (the API still returns 60 per page, split into three display pages).

components.name: Browse Return Restoration
components.description: KeepAlive caches up to 20 browse list, author and series pages in session memory with LRU eviction, retaining content, filters, loaded pagination and main-content scroll on return from details, without initial skeletons or remount fetches. Login/account changes clear the cache; inactive pages pause infinite loading and refresh shortcuts. Artwork viewer and novel reader themselves are not cached. On first mount, Home restores up to 120 cards from a same-account snapshot no older than 24 hours and refreshes in the background; pending or failed refresh retains cards, errors remain readable, and unconfirmed accounts never restore snapshots.

components.name: Bookmark Page
components.description: Own-bookmarks page: content-width type secondary tabs plus a right-aligned a public/private pill segmented toggle (surface-container track, primary-container selected); full-width wrapping tag band with 36px surface-container pills, primary-container selection and aria-pressed; at most three rows / 132px then internal scrolling, names capped at 192px with ellipsis and title, counts at 12px/600, empty name shown as Untagged; full-width total line + WorkGrid with hover Remove-bookmark action. Other users' public bookmarks (author tab) stay rest=show without the remove action.

components.name: History Page
components.description: Browsing-history grid page reached from the Library / Browsing history: header with back + title + Refresh and a danger Clear-history text button (disabled when empty); a repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px,1fr)) grid of WorkCards (self-drawn numbered pagination, not the infinite-scroll WorkGrid); pagination uses the shared App Pagination default variant (total line + 20/50/100 page-size selector, default 20, capacity change returns to page 1); Clear confirms in a native dialog (single-line body, same recipe as the task-history delete confirm) then reports the clear, returns to page 1 and reloads; static surface-container skeletons (no shimmer), illustration empty state and readable error with retry; when the global R-18 toggle is off the grid filters x_restrict at render time (no data or pagination-total change, same shared filter as other lists) and a filtered-empty page appends the hidden-count helper line under the empty state.

components.name: Bookmark Button
components.description: Detail topbar bookmark trigger aligned to the outlined-button spec (40px pill, 18px heart): outline heart + Bookmark when empty, filled heart + Bookmarked with a Private badge when restrict=1; opens a native details popup (surface-container, 12px radius, the single legal overlay shadow) offering public/private add or remove; disabled with aria-busy while in flight, closes on outside pointerdown or Escape.

components.name: Detail Topbar Actions
components.description: Shared action row of the artwork viewer and the novel reader top bars: labeled actions stay at the 40px outlined pill (bookmark, see Bookmark Button), while icon actions use md-icon-button (40x40, no outline, on-surface-variant icon, selected state via Material's toggle/selected) with a uniform 20px official Lucide inline SVG (stroke 2), ordered bookmark / comments / fill-form / open-in-browser. An icon-only md-outlined-button is not allowed here - its 24px inline padding stretches a single icon into a ~66px wide pill - and a text glyph (chevron, cross) never stands in for an icon; browse pagers and the ranking date switcher follow the same md-icon-button + 20px chevron recipe, with md-text-button kept for labeled low-emphasis actions.

components.name: Detail Panel
components.description: Switchable lower panel shared by the viewer's right 320px info column and the novel reader's column: related works by default, comments once the topbar comment button is on (an md-icon-button toggle with selected state - filled bubble in primary - whose label flips between Show comments and Back to recommendations). Comments mount only when the panel is switched on, so their first page is fetched on open; roots then grow through load-more pagination and replies page in after expansion. Switching scrolls the panel into view (novel: block start with a 72px sticky-topbar margin; viewer: block nearest), and changing work (kind/id) resets the panel to related works.

components.name: R18 Quick Filter
components.description: Channel-page top row: a Content filter label with three pill options (All / General / R-18); the pills use the same recipe as the discover page filter chips (transparent background, 1px outline at 60%, --ink text, 13px/600; selected = secondary-container / on-secondary-container with transparent border, hover = 8% on-surface state layer), the existing 4-12px spacing, no new tokens. Selection is expressed with aria-pressed, keyboard reachable, focus-visible primary 2px ring. Defaults to the global show_r18 setting; a manual choice covers only the current channel page (illustration / manga / novel keep independent states and never leak into each other) and never rewrites settings. Entering or leaving R-18 loads the corresponding server channel snapshot (mode=r18 for restricted, ordinary snapshot shared by All/General), clears old cards while existing skeletons load, and uses the existing error/retry state on failure; only the latest request may update the page. WorkGrid uses the explicit channel filter without stacking the global filter; tag recommendations come from the same snapshot and ranking/tag navigation inherits the content mode. The hidden count reuses the auxiliary-line level (12px, --ink-subtle = outline role), never a heading level or a card badge; an all-filtered page does not change the server paging decision.

components.name: Fullscreen Viewer
components.description: Fullscreen overlay opened from the viewer stage: Wheel down / PageDown advances, wheel up / PageUp goes back, one page in single mode and one pair in spread mode, independent of RTL; no wrap at bounds. Wheel paging has a 250ms minimum interval, while the filmstrip retains native scrolling. Horizontal and Ctrl/Meta wheel gestures do not page; typing targets and modified Ctrl/Meta/Alt/Shift PageUp/PageDown do not page. Hover or focus over a scrollable filmstrip delegates PageUp/PageDown to shared page scrolling without switching artwork pages. Existing aria-live page labels, disabled boundary buttons and exit focus restoration remain in use. it carries its own neutral dark backdrop rgb(0 0 0 / 0.78) - the viewer's only remaining dark exception, since the inline stage now shares the page surface - and must not spread to ordinary content containers. Each page box is sized as min(available width, (viewport height - overlay padding) x page aspect ratio), so portrait pages fill the height and landscape pages fill the width, and small images are scaled up to that box instead of being capped at their pixel size; one page per screen, or two side by side (8px gap) in spread mode. The bottom control bar (prev/next, page range, two-page-spread toggle, reading-direction toggle) and the top-right close button are hidden by default (opacity 0, pointer-events none) and fade in over 0.15s when the pointer enters the bottom strip or top-right hot zone or when they receive keyboard focus; they stay visible on hover-less (touch) devices and the transition is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Spread mode pairs pages 1-2 / 3-4 (clicking any filmstrip thumbnail lands on its pair), advances two pages at a time, shows a page range, highlights the whole pair in the filmstrip, and can read right-to-left (default) or left-to-right - right-to-left mirrors the paging group so the forward button moves to the left with its chevron flipped to point left and ArrowLeft advances, while the spread and direction toggles are not directional controls and never mirror; both preferences are remembered per session only. Escape or a click outside the image closes. The right side is a filmstrip rail fixed at 80px (64px square thumbnails at the grid tier, 12px radius, 8px gaps, self-scrolling with a 6px always-visible scrollbar that never auto-hides, never scrolling horizontally - thumbnails shrink to the remaining rail width once the scrollbar appears, staying square - kept on narrow windows) where the on-screen pages carry a white 2px ring and the primary page carries aria-current, a click jumps straight to that page, and the active thumbnail auto-scrolls into view while paging; the filmstrip only appears for multi-page works.

components.name: Watchlist Page
components.description: Series watchlist mirroring the official /following/watchlist: a Type label row with manga/novel secondary tabs; row series cards in a repeat(auto-fill, minmax(360px,1fr)) grid holding a 2:3 112px cover (12px radius), a 'Series' 12px overline, a 16px/600 two-line title, a 20px round-avatar author row and 'N episodes - date' 12px meta. Filled 'Read latest' (34px) is the primary action shared with the whole-card click (disabled when no latest work); the actions row is a sibling of the clickable area, indented to the info column (no indent under 640px). Both card kinds add a 'Series contents' entry into the in-app series episode page (novel cards → the novel segment; manga cards are watchlist semantics mapped to the illust segment). 8% primary hover, no shadow, no new motion; subscriptions are user-curated so no R-18 render-time filter applies; static surface-container skeleton blocks and centered empty/error states with retry.

components.name: Download Workspace
components.description: Non-modal layout panel: 480px right column at workspace container widths >=1120px; otherwise a bottom row of min(45%,320px), independently scrollable, with no scrim, shadow or focus trap. Novel/artwork secondary tabs inherit the surface-container panel background via --md-secondary-tab-container-color. Shared novel/artwork form and session-only drafts; overwrite edited sources requires confirmation, formats are kept. Opening/prefilling changes neither route nor history; closing/navigation keeps drafts, account changes reset them. Errors keep inputs, submission disables duplicates, success closes and reports via Snackbar without leaving the page. Preserve the visible card anchor or scroll offset when the layout changes. A reserved 32px surface-container status row (12px text) is always visible except in fullscreen: click progress to navigate to full tasks, New download opens form. Active count includes running/pending/paused; representative follows that priority then ascending created_at. Mini progress 120px (48px below 640px), done/total or indeterminate for unknown totals, paused has no animation. Failed sync retains snapshot and shows retry status. One app-lifetime task subscription with 2-second polling while active or failing.

components.name: Global Search
components.description: Fixed circular 56px md-filled-tonal-icon-button with 24px lucide search, no visible text, accessible Search label and shortcut tooltip, right space-xl / bottom 3*space-xl in main pane, above reserved status and bottom panel. When visible, reserve 72px (button 56px + gap 16px) at the inline end of every AppPagination so controls wrap outside the floating button area at any scroll position. Search page hides it; novel reader uses the topbar, fullscreen hides search. Ctrl+K/Command+K navigates and focuses search; dialogs/fullscreen block it. Image search is a text action in the search page.

narrative.overview: A compact desktop tool that uses Material 3 color roles and Material Web controls for Pixiv capture tasks.

rules.name: The Material Role Rule
rules.body: Use existing M3 color roles rather than a second color system.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Primary never means success, failure or warning; error, warning, progress and task states always pair a readable label with the color.

rules.name: The Truncation Rule
rules.body: History table titles and authors ellipsize and keep a title attribute; other long text must not shrink in font size to buy space.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows identify menus and snackbar overlays, not routine cards.

rules.name: The Compact Task Rule
rules.body: Alignment, whitespace and wrapping serve scannability of tasks, history and settings rather than manufacturing large empty areas.

rules.name: Page Scrolling
rules.body: All vertically scrollable data areas support plain PageUp/PageDown. Pick the innermost actually scrollable area under the pointer, then the focused area, then the main content. Scroll 87.5% of its visible height with reading overlap, clamped at bounds without moving sibling or parent scrollers. Modal scopes never scroll their background. Preserve native behavior in input, select, slider, contenteditable and shadow controls, modified keys and already consumed events. Fullscreen artwork keeps logical page/spread navigation, while hover or focus over a scrollable filmstrip scrolls the filmstrip. No new visual controls or motion.

rules.name: The Native-First Rule
rules.body: Reuse Material Web and native semantics before adding local component styles.

dos: Use Material Web controls and M3 color roles.
Keep task state textual as well as colored.
Preserve the 640px responsive rules and reduced-motion override.
donts: Don't restore Naive UI or the prior blue-white design language.
Don't add shadows to ordinary cards.
Don't use primary as a success, warning or error color.
